description: Baseline capability for the main window. Without a capability file the production bundle blocks the IPC bridge entirely (the dev profile is permissive and hides this). `core:event:default` enables the event listening Plume uses for drag-drop, and is the minimum needed for the frontend to reach our custom `#[tauri::command]` handlers (project / fs). Keep this list as narrow as possible — broaden only with a comment naming the new caller.
